chapters.title: Meet the Traffic Cop
chapters.blurb: A dispatcher deals requests like cards, routes around dead servers, ends encryption at the door, and then doubles itself.

chapters.title: Layer Four, Layer Seven
chapters.blurb: Layer four reads the envelope and forwards it fast; layer seven opens the letter and routes video and billing to different rooms.

chapters.title: The Edge of the Earth
chapters.blurb: DNS turns a name into an address, a CDN edge absorbs the ocean, and the bill for scaling out finally comes due.
